text:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert: cross-region health flapping detected. smart-router reports >300 failovers/min between us-east <-> us-west <-> eu. Error spike and latency increase for generation endpoints. paging @maria (oncall)

maria (oncall): i’m on it. getting paged — can someone grab quick topology? which policy rolled out at 03:12?

sam (sre): rolling log tail now. looks like a policy push rolled a 'circular_fallback' variant to smart-router cluster canary at 03:11. That combined with aggressive probe retry backoff 0s -> 0s caused immediate bounce.

alex (eng-run): oh — that new policy was the canary we were testing for cost-tier routing. It had fallback_order: [us-east, us-west, eu] and allow_circular: true (oops).

jonathan (prodops): impact: 2.6x p99 latency for text-gen in NA + EMEA, 4% 5xx rate increase. Some customers on Dedicated saw degraded throughput.

kevin (support): tickets mounting — a customer reported timeouts at 03:15 and is still seeing intermittent 502s. CS looped in.

emily (cs): prepping customer-facing note if needed. hold until we have mitigation.

maria (oncall): immediate mitigations: 1) remove canary policy from routing table 2) set routing grace period to 30s to dampen flaps 3) temporarily pin heavy traffic customers to stable us-east. Who can run the policy disable?

sam (sre): I can run. doing:```bash
# remove canary policy from smart-router
curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/v1/routing/policies/canary-disable -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
# confirm
curl https://controlplane/api/v1/routing/active | jq '.policies'
```

deploy-bot: policy canary-disable started by sam. id: db-31415

sam (sre): policy marked inactive. verifying fallthrough. logs show fallbacks still occurring because probes are still tripping downstream health.

maria (oncall): okay next — increase healthcheck hysteresis on smart-router probes and throttle probe frequency to avoid immediate re-eval. jonathan, can you change probe config?

jonathan (prodops): applying patch to probe config:```yaml
probe:
  interval: 10s -> 30s
  consecutive_failures: 3 -> 5
  jitter: 0-5s
```

jonathan (prodops): patch applied to us-east/us-west/eu routing pools. rolling out now.

alex (eng-run): we should also disable allow_circular flag globally until we have a safe rollout plan. sam can you flip that in controlplane?

sam (sre): issuing command:```bash
PATCH /api/v1/routing/config { "allow_circular": false }
```

sam (sre): patched, propagating. smart-router instances report config sync in ~12s.

maria (oncall): monitoring metrics. show me the smart-router trace that demonstrates the loop.

sam (sre): snippet from router log:```text
[03:14:22] route request id=abc123 -> us-west(healthy?) -> probe fail -> fallback eu -> eu probe fail -> fallback us-east -> us-west
[03:14:23] route request id=abc124 -> us-east -> eu -> us-west -> timeout
```

sam (sre): you can see circular fallbacks because allow_circular=true + short probe hysteresis.

maria (oncall): ok good. current status: policy canary off, allow_circular false, probe interval increased. any customer-facing impact left?

jonathan (prodops): latency improving — p99 down from 2.6x to 1.1x baseline over last 3 minutes. 5xx trending down.

kevin (support): one customer still on timeouts — looks like dedicated pool for their org had KV cache OOM and was cycling. I’m opening a dedicated follow-up with infra.

emily (cs): telling impacted customers we have mitigations in place, will update if anything else.

maria (oncall): next steps: 1) follow-up postmortem owner (sam) 2) patch CI to reject allow_circular=true unless explicit flag 3) run a rollout of a safer fallback strategy (failover, weighted) with canary traffic cap 4) inform customers who saw errors.

sam (sre): assigned postmortem. immediate action item: add guardrail in controlplane UI + API to prevent circular fallbacks. filing PR now.

alex (eng-run): also add e2e test that simulates probe jitter across regions to catch this class of flapping.

maria (oncall): handoff to daytime oncall @sam in 20m. I’ll stay available for 10m to verify stabilization then hand off.

incident-bot: incident auto-update: status=mitigated, severity=seV2->SEV3 (customer impact reduced), duration so far=00:45:20

maria (oncall): thanks team. continuing to monitor. I'll post final summary after postmortem doc is ready. :thumbsup:
